ns2:course.label: Mathematical Economics
ns2:course.description: (ECON 375) Introduction to game theory with applications to economics; emphasizes the analysis of static and dynamic games with or without complete information. 3 undergraduate hours. 2 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: MATH 125, MATH 225, or MATH 415; MATH 242 or equivalent; ECON 302.
